items.html: If you say, “Why were the general Hassadim and Gevurot not in the general account of the upper AVI as they were counted in Malchut of Israel Saba and Tvuna?” We must understand that it is known that the phase of crown is in the upper third of Tifferet, which is the phase of Malchut, and she is incorporated in Yesod. Here, however, she, Malchut of Tvuna, is more revealed than Malchut of Bina, since Malchut of Tvuna is actually Malchut with respect to the general Bina and Tvuna together in one Partzuf, but Malchut of the upper Bina is the Guf of the generality. It is the place of the Chazeh of Tifferet of the generality of Partzuf Bina and Tvuna together, and it is not the actual Malchut.
